newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC says optimstic on ROE goal.
newsitem.headline: SBC says optimstic on ROE goal.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp said it was optimistic that it was on its way to meeting a medium-term goal for return on equity (ROE) of 15 percent.

"Swiss Bank Corporation is confident that it will make further progress in 1997 towards its medium-term target of achieving an after-tax return on equity of 15 percent," SBC said in a statement to present its 1996 results.

"Against a background of low interest rates and attractive financial markets, (SBC) is optimistic about the future progress of its businesses. This optimism is founded on the strong market positioning of its four divisions and the programmes already initiated to optimise its cost base," it said.

In its results statements, SBC presented details of its ROE for 1996. It showed Group ROE at 10.1 percent, on average equity of 14 billion Swiss francs. It showed SBC Warburg's ROE at 16.4 percent, and SBC Switzerland's ROE was a minus 1.7 percent. It gave no ROE figures for SBC private banking, SBC Brinson or for its corporate centre. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
